title: Product compactification identity for the exchange/projection composite
statement:
Fix primes $p\ne\ell$, an integer $a\geq1$, $k=\overline{\mathbf F_{p^a}}$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $A_{E,m}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^m$ for $m\geq1$. Use a six-functor datum [def-sf-datum] with its specified canonical exchange and projection transformations [def-exchange-projection, def-sf-pf]. All schemes below are separated finite-type $k$-schemes and all morphisms are separated of finite type. Integral pullbacks and tensors are completed; field operations use rationalization and common finite stages. Fix finite coefficients $\Lambda=A_{E,n}$, $n\geq1$. For $f:X\to B$, $g:Y\to B$, put $T=X\times_BY$, with projections $p:T\to X$, $q:T\to Y$, and $t=fp=gq$. For $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\Lambda)$ and $L\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\Lambda)$ put $F=Rf_!K$, $G=Rg_!L$, $D=Lp^*K\otimes^L_\Lambda Lq^*L$. Define $\Psi_g(F,L)$ to be the composite $F\otimes^LG\xrightarrow{\sigma}G\otimes^LF\xrightarrow{\operatorname{PF}_{g,L,F}}Rg_!(L\otimes^LLg^*F)\xrightarrow{Rg_!\sigma}Rg_!(Lg^*F\otimes^LL)$, and define
$$\lambda_{f,g}(K,L)=\alpha_{g,q}\circ Rg_!\bigl(\operatorname{PF}_{q,Lp^*K,L}\circ(\operatorname{Ex}_{f,g}(K)\otimes1_L)\bigr)\circ\Psi_g(F,L):F\otimes^LG\longrightarrow Rt_!D,$$
where $\alpha_{g,q}:Rg_!Rq_!\xrightarrow{\sim}Rt_!$ is the supplied composition comparison and $\operatorname{Ex}_{f,g}:Lg^*Rf_!\to Rq_!Lp^*$ is the canonical exchange. Choose compactifications $f=aj$, $g=bk$, with $j:X\hookrightarrow\bar X$, $k:Y\hookrightarrow\bar Y$ open and $a:\bar X\to B$, $b:\bar Y\to B$ proper. Put $\bar T=\bar X\times_B\bar Y$, $u=j\times_Bk:T\hookrightarrow\bar T$, $c:\bar T\to B$. Let
$$e_{j,k}:(j_!K)\boxtimes(k_!L)\xrightarrow{\sim}u_!(K\boxtimes L)$$
be the normalized canonical open external-tensor comparison of [lem-sf-open-external-tensor-normalization]. Through the supplied compactification comparisons $Rf_!K\cong Ra_*j_!K$, $Rg_!L\cong Rb_*k_!L$, $Rt_!D\cong Rc_*u_!D$, one has the equality of specified morphisms
$$\lambda_{aj,bk}(K,L)=Rc_*(e_{j,k})\circ\lambda_{a,b}(j_!K,k_!L).$$
The equality is compatible with the refinement comparisons for the chosen compactifications.
